name: book-index-tiering
title: book-index.md gains a nano tier, and full-book loading stops being unconditional
outcome: book-index.md offers nano, mini, and full tiers for all 14 vendored books, and its escalation rule requires a minimum of three nano loads before any book may be judgment-escalated to mini or full.
done_when: books/README.md's manifest lists nano.md, mini.md, and full.md for each of the 14 books
book-index.md states the 3-nano-minimum, judgment-gated escalation rule, replacing the prior 1-primary-plus-1-companion cap for book loading
design-mode.md's Stage 1/3 grounding section and the architecture skill's Review/Maintenance corpus-to-book escalation both reference the new rule

min_work.derived_from: 1 district (skills), 2 colliding ADRs (ADR-0015, ADR-0017), 1 boundary rule (book-index.md's own prior 1+1 cap)
